summary: Narrow retest of the caption filter fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/caption.js (the single failing item from iteration_5). The regex was updated to /\(\d+\)\s*$/. Verified live at /gallery: 76 total demo-photo cards, exactly 5 carry a caption overlay in the DOM (all 5 room=bedroom, all with genuine unique captions like 'Textured wall tiling in the bedroom display...'), and 71 boilerplate cards (bathroom=18, kitchen=7, living=19, floor=16, wall=7, outdoor=4) render with NO caption span at all — only the gold room-tag pill remains. Zero leaks of the trailing '(N)' pattern were found. Filter chips (Bedroom / Bathroom / Living) confirmed: Bedroom -> 5/5 captions present, Bathroom -> 0/18, Living -> 0/19. Regression on /tiles/bedroom 'See the look': all 5 room-look-card-* cards show their real captions, no boilerplate leaks. Fix is fully verified; no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: displayCaption() in src/lib/caption.js is now correct and minimal — the /\(\d+\)\s*$/ pattern is a clean, robust hide rule that matches the seeded boilerplate '(N)' suffix and leaves genuine unique captions (bedroom set) untouched.
Consider extracting a small unit test for displayCaption() at src/lib/__tests__/caption.test.js to prevent future regressions (5 positive + 5 negative cases).

The caption overlay span is correctly conditional ({caption && ...}) in both DemoPhotoCard.jsx and RoomCategory.jsx, so the DOM is clean when caption is null — good for accessibility and screen readers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all caption assertions pass: 5 retained, 71 hidden, 0 leaks, filter chips consistent, RoomCategory /tiles/bedroom retained all 5)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing 76 demo photos confirmed intact (bathroom=18, kitchen=7, living=19, floor=16, wall=7, outdoor=4, bedroom=5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_5's single failing item (generic caption leak) is now RESOLVED. Full app state is passing. Any future work should not need to re-verify caption filtering unless src/lib/caption.js changes.
rca of the issue: Original bug: displayCaption regex matched only 'on display at our showroom' but seeded captions read '<Room> display at our showroom (N)', '<X> collection in our stockyard (N)', 'Showroom interior display (N)', etc. Fix: broadened regex to /\(\d+\)\s*$/ which hides any caption ending in a parenthesized number — matches all 71 boilerplate captions and preserves the 5 bedroom captions that lack that trailing pattern. Verified end-to-end on live preview URL.
